content:
[L] high | bottom half of window | entire region below the "Rows (2)" card is solid black — an unrendered/unpainted canvas occupying ~60% of the screen, the most severe defect possible
[L] high | bottom-left card | "Rows (2)" card is clipped: shows only a header, search box, and two bare row numbers (1, 2) with content cut off at the card and window bottom edge
[C] high | whole screen | ~60% of the viewport is dead empty black space while all content is crushed into the top 40%, catastrophically unbalanced composition
[S] high | bottom-left card | card is left-anchored with a ragged right edge ending mid-screen, not aligned to the table width above nor the window edge
[S] med | row 1 "Billing export" | selected-row pill overlaps the NAME column cell and collides visually with the cursor, and the selection treatment (solid black pill) is inconsistent with unselected rows
[S] med | actions column | refresh/Edit/Delete button groups on all three rows have zero gap between refresh and Edit/Delete clusters, making them read as one cramped blob per row
[S] med | Delete buttons | three large saturated red buttons stacked in a column create a dominant red block whose vertical spacing differs from the rest of the row rhythm
[C] med | action column | destructive "Delete" is the most visually prominent control on the screen, heavier than primary "New Connector" — inverted button hierarchy
[H] med | table rows | connector names ("Billing export", "Changelog feed", "Status page") carry no more visual weight than metadata like "manual" or timestamps; primary entity is not distinguishable
[H] med | header area | "Connectors" title, description, "3 connectors" count, and button all sit at similar small sizes with no clear typographic hierarchy
[H] low | table headers | NAME/HEALTH/REFRESH/LAST SYNC all-caps micro-labels are near-uniform gray and read as debug output
[S] low | LAST SYNC column | "—" placeholder and timestamps are left-aligned inconsistently relative to the header, and timestamps use inconsistent emphasis vs "manual"
[C] low | rows panel | "Rows (2)" widget floats disconnected from the connectors table with no label explaining what rows are shown or how they relate
[S] low | header top-left | title and description touch the very top window edge with no top margin, while right-side elements have padding — inconsistent inset

VERDICT: unprofessional — a half-black unrendered canvas, clipped panels, and a red destructive-button block dominate a screen that reads as a debug build, not a product.
